tasks.label: Compilar e abrir Amazonia
args: export PATH=/ucrt64/bin:/usr/bin:$PATH; pkg-config --print-errors --exists allegro-5 allegro_image-5 allegro_primitives-5 allegro_font-5 && gcc -std=c11 -Wall -Wextra -g main.c movimento.c moedas.c cards.c perguntas.c -o amazonia.exe $(pkg-config --cflags --libs allegro-5 allegro_image-5 allegro_primitives-5 allegro_font-5) && ./amazonia.exe
